name: @local/dsh-vault-tab
description: Vault tab: list the configured vault folder, search and read it (grep-first over names and summaries), write into it with the vault_* tools (note from template with lint, move with link upkeep, delete behind a link check) gated by a per-session Vault Grant, and commit the vault repository with vault_git only after a clean integrity audit and the user's explicit word.

scripts.test: node test/vault-tools.test.mjs && node test/link-engine.test.mjs && node test/link-canonical.test.mjs && node test/vault-git.test.mjs
